<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919663_theRebbe_89" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919663_theRebbe_89__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the date and occasion for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">The third day, which was doubled with "it was good,"</t>
    <t s="2">Erev Rosh Chodesh Menachem-Av,</t>
    <t s="3">5735*.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section indicates that the following is an unedited discourse.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">An unedited discourse.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Zion shall be redeemed with justice" is from Yeshayahu, whose prophecies are entirely comfort and salvation, including through sweetened gevuros.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her captives with charity."</t>
    <t s="1">Now, this verse is at the beginning of the book of Yeshayahu,</t>
    <t s="2">whose subject matter</t>
    <t s="3">(of Yeshayahu)</t>
    <t s="4">is as his name implies</t>
    <t s="5">(Yeshayahu from the word yeshuah—salvation),</t>
    <t s="6">and as it is stated in the Gemara:</t>
    <t s="7">"All of Yeshayahu is consolation."</t>
    <t s="8">And even those matters in the prophecies of Yeshayahu that seemingly are not salvation,</t>
    <t s="9">in truth they too are salvation and consolation,</t>
    <t s="10">as is explained in Kabbalah</t>
    <t s="11">that they are aspects of sweetened gevuros (might/severities),</t>
    <t s="12">and because the salvation</t>
    <t s="13">(redemption)</t>
    <t s="14">of the future will be through the sweetening of the gevuros,</t>
    <t s="15">therefore Yitzchak will be the main one, etc.</t>
    <t s="16">[And as it is stated in the Gemara,</t>
    <t s="17">that in the future they will say to Yitzchak</t>
    <t s="18">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="19">"for you are our father,"</t>
    <t s="20">for Yitzchak is the aspect of gevuros],</t>
    <t s="21">therefore in the salvations in the book of Yeshayahu there are the salvations in the aspect of revealed chassadim (kindnesses),</t>
    <t s="22">and the salvations of the aspect of sweetened gevuros,</t>
    <t s="23">gevuros that are transformed into chassadim</t>
    <t s="24">(which are loftier</t>
    <t s="25">than revealed chassadim).</t>
    <t s="26">And likewise is it also with the prophecy at the beginning of the book,</t>
    <t s="27">which contains the two aforementioned types,</t>
    <t s="28">concluding with the two [matters]: "Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her captives with charity,"</t>
    <t s="29">as will be explained further.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
